confidence_notes: Food estimates use reported Brno typical prices. City-wide cocktail data is limited, so cocktails are estimated relative to local draft beer; wine is estimated at about 1.4 times the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic July estimates without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used; food anchors are based on Brno prices, and accommodation estimates reflect a mid-sized Central European regional city.
